full.en: ORGANIC BODY CLEANSE MUESLI with sprouted granola, psyllium husk & lots of seeds. Ingredients: OAT flakes * (43%), WHEAT flakes * (WHEAT, BARLEY malt extract) (19%), sunflower seeds * (11%), SESAME seeds * (8%), buckwheat * (6%), sprouted 4 seed granola * (buckwheat, SESAME seeds, sunflower seeds, flax seeds, figs, apricots, raisins) (5%), pumpkin seeds * (5%), psyllium husk * (2%), cinnamon * (1%). * organic. Contains naturally present sugars. May contain traces: PEANUTS, SOY, MILK and NUTS. Storage: Store in a cool and dry place. Neto weight 350 g. Best before end: see top of the bag.
full.sl: BIOMUESLIZAČIŠČENJETELESA z granolo iz kaljenih semen, indijskim trpotcem in veliko semeni. Uporabno najmanj do: datum odtisnjen na zgornjem delu vrečke.

full.it: ORGANICBODYCLEANSEMUESLIcon granola germogliata, buccia di psillio e tanti semi. Da consumarsi preferibilmente entro: vedere la parte superiore del sacchetto. full.sk: ORGANIC BODY CLEANSE MUESLI s naklíčenou granolou, psylliovými šupkami a množstvom semienok.
